note: Full snapshot of the program catalog, all pages of every category. Availability and waitlists change daily — always send people to the section_url or category_url for current status and to register. Cost is shown as resident/non-resident.

programs.name: Preschool Swim Lessons- Fall 1
programs.description: Preschool Swim Lessons (Ages 3–5, Levels 1–3) Our preschool swim lessons focus on water comfort, basic safety skills, and introducing foundational strokes. Classes are grouped by skill level to ensure age-appropriate instruction and progress.

programs.name: Junior Lifeguard - Fall 2
programs.description: Come learn what it takes to be a lifeguard with lessons and activities in water safety, swimming skills, the importance of being a lifeguard, and have the opportunity to earn an American Red Cross CPR/AED for the Professional Rescuer certification!*Please note that this program does not certify anyone to become a lifeguard.Prerequisites: Participants must be able to swim 100 yards continuously to participate in this program.

programs.name: Youth Swim Lessons - Fall 1
programs.description: Youth Swim Lessons (Ages 6–12, Levels 1-6) Youth group lessons focus on water comfort, basic safety skills, and introducing foundational strokes in levels 1-3. Levels 4-6 are designed to build on skills learned in levels 1-3 to develop stroke technique, endurance, and continued water safety knowledge. It is strongly encouraged that all group swim lesson participants attend a Lesson Placement Day to help determine the appropriate level before registering. If you choose to enroll without attending a placement day and later need to switch levels, we cannot guarantee availability in your preferred level. Please note: If your child is enrolled in a level that is too advanced for their current abilities, their enrollment will be canceled. A refund will be issued. Purchases made by card will be subject to a 10% administrative fee.

programs.name: Aqua Zumba
programs.description: A lot impact but high intensity water aerobics class where no swimming skills are needed. This class is designed to improve flexibility, range of motion, strength, muscle bone, and cardiovascular endurance while using the resistance of the water to cushion the feet, knees, and back.

programs.name: Lesson Placement Days - September
programs.description: Lesson Placement Days give you guidance on what level to register for. Our instructors will spend a few minutes in the water to assess current skills and recommend the best level for a safe, successful, and fun swim experience. Placement days are available prior to program registration for all group lessons.

programs.name: Lesson Placement Days - October
programs.description: Lesson Placement Days give you guidance on what level to register for. Our instructors will spend a few minutes in the water to assess current skills and recommend the best level for a safe, successful, and fun swim experience. Placement days are available prior to program registration for all group lessons.

programs.name: Lesson Placement Days - November
programs.description: Lesson Placement Days give you guidance on what level to register for. Our instructors will spend a few minutes in the water to assess current skills and recommend the best level for a safe, successful, and fun swim experience. Placement days are available prior to program registration for all group lessons.

programs.name: Pre-Lifeguard Conditioning
programs.description: Pre-Lifeguard Conditioning is for anyone ages 14 years and older with interest in becoming a lifeguard! This time offers participants the opportunity to practice the prerequisite skills in preparation for the American Red Cross Lifeguarding Course.

programs.name: Spanish for Preschoolers
programs.description: Learn the fundamental language skills needed for everyday interaction in Spanish. Everyday words, simple questions and answers are covered through fun and engaging age-appropriate songs, games, play-based activities, and craft projects from our native-speaking Spanish Teacher.

programs.name: DK Acting Academy
programs.description: This immersive acting class offers a dive into theatre while focusing on the real-world skills teens need most in today's tech-driven world. No prior experience is required. Through improv, role-play, character work, and scene study, students strengthen their communication, collaboration, and creative-thinking skills. The session concludes with a low-pressure showcase; a chance for students to share a scripted scene and demonstrate the skills and growth they’ve gained during the class.

programs.name: Tyke Time
programs.description: This program in the MAC gym is a wonderful opportunity to network with other parents as your child makes new friends. Parents provide supervision for this program. Equipment includes mats and play equipment such as balls, ride-on-toys, blocks, coloring, and more. Registration is required.

programs.name: Lil Builders Club
programs.description: Welcome to Lil Builders- a fun hands-on playtime just for preschoolers! Explore, create, and build using colorful building tiles and classic LEGO bricks in a relaxed, self-led environment. This open-ended play session encourages imagination, fine motor skills, and cooperative play. Whether they’re stacking towers, designing simple structures, or just experimenting with shapes and colors, your little builder is sure to have a blast!

programs.name: The Play Spot Class
programs.description: Expertly designed by a pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) and Occupational Therapist (OT), this dynamic program focuses on enhancing fine and gross motor skills, language development, and social interactions through stimulating and fun play activities. Children explore sensory bins, unleash their creativity with crafts, enjoy captivating stories, music and movement, and navigate exciting obstacle courses through engaging weekly themes. Enroll your child for an enriching experience that combines play and skill-building! To see our class in action and spot the upcoming class themes, find us on social media @theplayspotclass

programs.name: Active Adventures
programs.description: Active Adventures creates a fun, supportive environment where children develop essential motor and cognitive skills through play-based activities that encourage confidence, coordination, social growth, and a passion for staying active.

programs.name: Active Agility
programs.description: Active Agility is a play-based program that develops preschool and youth speed, agility, balance, coordination, and strength through fun drills, ladder exercises, cone activities, and reaction-based games.

programs.name: Kindertots
programs.description: Kindertots allows a two-year old’s natural curiosity to flourish in a multitude of ways with an emphasis on movement exploration. Young children enjoy a challenge, and when they are given the opportunity to test their abilities, it is both developmentally appropriate as well as safe.

programs.name: Kinderdance
programs.description: Kinderdance provides children with the potential to be creative, express themselves through movement while building strong muscles and social skills. Our age appropriate educational concepts reinforce what children are learning at home and in preschool, which builds self-confidence and self-esteem, making for very happy children.

programs.name: Spring Break Camp - Bally Sports Group
programs.description: Campers will have a ball participating in a variety of exciting sports and camp activities at the Hilliard Spring Break Camp! Children will be introduced to sports and engage in activities in a fun and encouraging way! Sports include soccer, basketball, flag football, ultimate Frisbee, volleyball, floor hockey and much more! Camp will also feature traditional camp games such as kickball, dodgeball, capture the flag, and more. Our coaches are trained to provide constant encouragement, constructive feedback, and to implement modifications for each skill level. Our camp will promote sportsmanship, respect, teamwork, positive social interactions, and the enjoyment of physical activity. Bally Sports Camps ensure that each camper has a great time while being physically active.

sections.title: Spring Break Camp - Bally Sports Group

programs.name: Jewelry Making Club
programs.description: Join others who love the same hobby of creating fun bracelets of all kinds. Hang out, listen to music, meet new friends, and learn how to make old and new designs. Beaded bracelets, friendship bracelets, clay bead bracelets, and more.

programs.name: Watercolor For Kids
programs.description: Nurture your child's creative side!! This watercolor class builds foundational artistic skills and allows individual expression in a fun environment. While learning, each student will create their own unique masterpiece!

programs.name: Young Chef Academy
programs.description: Discover the joys of cooking! Dive into hands-on cooking and baking, create delicious tastings, and learn essential culinary skills like following a recipe, meal prepping, food safety, and kitchen techniques. Please note: Due to the nature of the program, we cannot guarantee the absence of allergens like nuts, gluten, and dairy in the kitchen.

programs.name: Spring Break Camp with Young Chefs Academy
programs.description: Young Chefs Academy provides hands-on culinary education where children build confidence, creativity, kitchen safety, cooking skills, and teamwork while learning to prepare delicious recipes in a fun environment.

sections.title: Spring Break Camp with Young Chefs Academy

programs.name: Skin Care, Nails, and Home-made Spa Workshop
programs.description: Get ready for a fun day of making your own sugar scrubs and face masks, getting a mini manicure, and learning cool tips to take care of your skin! Plus, you’ll mix up a fancy layered juice drink to enjoy! It’s hands-on, creative, and all about feeling good and having fun with friends!

sections.title: Skin Care, Nails, and Home-made Spa Workshop

programs.name: Kidz Home Alone
programs.description: Through interactive activities and real-life scenarios, children learn to stay home alone safely, follow household rules, make responsible decisions, and feel more confident and prepared.

programs.name: Better Babysitters
programs.description: Tweens ages 10–13 learn childcare basics, CPR, first aid, emergency response, and babysitting responsibilities through hands-on activities. Each student receives a first aid kit.

programs.name: Plant and Grow
programs.description: Celebrate Earth Day by getting your hands dirty (in the best way)! In this fun, hands-on activity, kids will plant their very own succulent to take home and care for. Learn cool facts about plants, decorate your pot, and find out how even small things—like a tiny plant—can help the planet grow greener.

programs.name: Spanish Beginners
programs.description: Students in this class focus on verbal communication with native pronunciation while learning everyday communication in reading and writing, through fun and engaging student-to-student activities.

programs.name: KD Combo
programs.description: Learn fundamental dance skills and terms, progressing to more complex movements. Including Ballet, Tap, Jazz, and Creative Movement, blending age-appropriate education with enjoyable activities. Children dance, jump, glide, and use their imagination with a program certified teacher. Prerequisite: 5-year-old students requires completion of one session of Kinder dance for ages 3-5. Ballet shoes and tap shoes required. Recommended attire: leotard and tights or shorts/t-shirt/exercise clothing.

programs.name: Future Fashion Stars
programs.description: The GOOD VIBE CLUB - cozy sweats & awesome accessories Do you have a passion for fashion? Do you like being creative? How about having FUN with friends while you MAKE SOMETHING AWESOME!!

programs.name: KPOP DANCE
programs.description: Learn dance basics, choreography, and body coordination set to K-pop music! Each class consists of a warm-up, dance routine, and freestyle dance party. Families will be invited to a mini recital on the last day of class.

programs.name: Drama Kids- Its Showtime!
programs.description: This high-energy drama class invites kids to explore their creativity while building confidence, communication, and collaboration skills. Through theatre games, storytelling, improvisation, and expressive movement, students strengthen their voices, imagination, and stage presence…while also developing important life skills like leadership and teamwork. No prior experience is necessary; just curiosity and a positive attitude! Families will celebrate their child’s journey at a no-pressure showcase that highlights the kids’ growth, creativity, and fun!

programs.name: LEGO Robot BattleBot Blitz
programs.description: Build it. Code it. Battle it! Everyone builds and codes a LEGO robot, jousts, and battles. Take-home option available. Returning builders bring their robot and unlock Arena Power Pack.

programs.name: Beginning Drawing and Watercolor for Teenagers
programs.description: Teenagers can join this fun and supportive environment to explore drawing and watercolor while developing foundational artistic skills, watercolor techniques and develop creative confidence. More details at www.amysadventuresinart.com .

sections.title: Beginning Drawing and Watercolor for Teenagers

programs.name: Family Pizza and BINGO Night
programs.description: Come join us for an evening of food, fun, and family bonding! Gather around for pizza and dive into multiple rounds of classic bingo with exciting prizes. Whether you're a seasoned bingo pro or a first-time player, everyone can join in on the fun. With laughter, light-hearted competition, and plenty of chances to win, this event promises to be a memorable night for kids, parents, and grandparents alike. It’s the perfect way to relax, reconnect, and create lasting memories together. Registration is per person.

programs.name: Biz Kids Holiday Market
programs.description: Have a business idea you want to bring to life? Join our Biz Kids Market. Come show off your business creations and sell your homemade items. All participants will be responsible for their own payment method and cash collection. Table and 2 Chairs are provided. Event is free to the public. An adult needs to be present at all times.

programs.name: Mindfulness & Meditation: Coming Home to Yourself
programs.description: If you've ever said 'I can't meditate' — this is for you. A liberating, judgment-free hour exploring what meditation and mindfulness can look like in your real life.

sections.title: Mindfulness & Meditation: Coming Home to Yourself
Mindfulness & Meditation: Coming Home to Yourself

programs.name: Women’s Self Defense Class-HPD
programs.description: The Class is from 6:00-9:00 pm both nights and participants must be able to attend both nights.ONLY those that have completed the Hilliard Police Basic 8-hour Women’s Self Defense class are eligible to sign up.Participants should be physically and mentally prepared for the demands of this class which will include ground fighting.

sections.title: Advanced Women’s Self Defense Class

programs.name: Future Fashion Stars - Pop Star
programs.description: Sparkle and shine as we create stage worthy style from concept to collection. The students will work individually and as a team to create their designs.

programs.name: Global Chicken Three Ways
programs.description: Explore global flavors in this hands-on class featuring chicken three ways. Create rich Indian Butter Chicken with aromatic spices, Spanish-inspired Chicken Bravas with smoky tomato sauce and potatoes, and Italian Chicken Rollatini filled with herbs and cheese. Learn versatile techniques that transform simple chicken into bold, international comfort classics.

programs.name: Floating Sound Healing and Guided Meditation Experience
programs.description: Float on a large, sturdy mat and join us for a floating sound healing experience which is a deeply immersive, full body listening experience created by various instruments, which create sounds and harmonies that promote relaxation of the mind and body. These intentional sound vibrations permeate your mind, body, and spirit to nurture gentle therapeutic and restorative processes. These experiences are open to all physical abilities, skill levels, and ages and no prior meditation experience is required, but you may feel more comfortable with basic swimming skills.

sections.title: Floating Sound Healing and Guided Meditation Experience
Floating Sound Healing and Guided Meditation Experience

programs.name: Beginner Spanish Class
programs.description: Students learn everyday sentences and study the cultures of different Spanish-speaking countries. The class integrates play based activities, fun action games, student-to-student conversation, and age-appropriate Spanish music.

programs.name: Beginning/Intermediate Chess
programs.description: Students will learn world champion chess openings, incorporate critical thinking skills to devise plans, engage in pattern recognition exercises, cooperate with others in small group activities, and apply strategies in chess matches

programs.name: Holiday Watercolor Painting
programs.description: Connect with your creative side! Come for a relaxing beginner friendly watercolor class where you will make holiday themed decor and cards to show off to family and friends!

programs.name: DIY Holiday Chocolates: Sweet Gifts Made Simple
programs.description: Discover how to make irresistible holiday chocolate treats, from rich truffles to beautiful chocolate bark, perfect for gifting.

sections.title: DIY Holiday Chocolates: Sweet Gifts Made Simple

programs.name: Tyke Time
programs.description: A chance for parents to meet others while children play with age-appropriate equipment including ride-on-toys, large blocks, mats, tunnels, trucks, dolls, and more. Parents must provide supervision for their own children.

programs.name: Lil Builders Club
programs.description: Explore, create, and build using colorful building tiles and classic LEGO bricks in a relaxed, self-led environment. This open-ended, hands-on play session encourages imagination, fine motor skills, and cooperative play.

programs.name: Stories at the Well
programs.description: Drop your child off while they enjoy a story each week incorporating additional activities which may include art, science & nature, creative dramatics, and music & movement. Children must be potty trained. Registration in advance is required. Parents are not required to stay on site.

programs.name: Once Upon a Tumble
programs.description: The primary goal of Stories in Motion classes are to foster a love of movement, literacy, and imaginative play in young children through engaging, storybook-inspired classes. The program is designed to support early childhood development by encouraging physical activity, creativity, confidence, social interaction, and early literacy skills in a fun, welcoming, and community-centered environment.

sections.title: Stories in Motion-Once Upon a Tumble
Stories in Motion-Once Upon a Tumble

programs.name: Ornament Party - Preschool
programs.description: Join your preschool friends for a holiday ornament crafting session! You and your child create one-of-a-kind decorations that double as thoughtful gifts for family members.

programs.name: Preschool Spanish
programs.description: Learn the fundamental language skills needed for everyday interaction in Spanish. Everyday words, simple questions and answers are covered through fun and engaging age-appropriate songs, games, play-based activities, and craft projects from our native-speaking Spanish Teacher.

programs.name: Kindertots Dance
programs.description: Watch your child thrive as they develop essential gross motor skills, unleash their creative movement, and build physical strength and body awareness—all while learning numbers, colors, shapes, and fun, engaging songs!

programs.name: Kinderdance Combo
programs.description: Learn fundamental dance skills and terms, progressing to more complex movements. Including Ballet, Tap, Jazz, and Creative Movement, blending age-appropriate education with enjoyable activities. Children dance, jump, glide, and use their imagination with a program certified teacher. Prerequisite: 5-year-old students requires completion of one session of Kinder dance for ages 3-5. Ballet shoes and tap shoes required. Recommended attire: leotard and tights or shorts/t-shirt/exercise clothing.

programs.name: Kinderdance
programs.description: Come join this developmental dance, motor skill, music, and fitness program, blended with academics, specifically designed for boys and girls ages 3-5. Parents who want to give their child the opportunity to dance will love how Kinderdance® teaches the basics of Ballet, Tap, Acrobatics and Creative Movement while blending educational concepts, designed to teach to the total child. * This class requires ballet shoes and tap shoes.

programs.name: Winter Break Camp
programs.description: Your campers will get the opportunity to stay active, engaged, and social during the holiday season. Each day is packed with winter-themed games, creative arts and crafts, outdoor play (weather permitting), and hands-on activities designed to spark imagination and fun.

programs.name: Kids Night Out
programs.description: While the kids play, parents can enjoy a worry-free night! With the kids having fun at the community center with camp games, art projects, board games, and pizza, parents are free to plan an evening for themselves ahead of the holidays. All participants must be potty trained.

programs.name: Better BabySitters
programs.description: The perfect first job preparation! Learn the responsibilities of having a job, the Rights of a Babysitter, CPR for a child and infant, basic first aid, growth and development, and appropriate toys and activities for kids. Diaper changing, infant care, and how to feed a toddler are also covered. Students will receive a fully stocked First Aid kit, a student manual and certificate of completion.

programs.name: Beginner Watercolor for Kids
programs.description: Nurture your child's creative side!! This watercolor class builds foundational artistic skills and allows individual expression in a fun environment. While learning, each student will create their own unique masterpiece!

programs.name: The Great Gingerbread Build
programs.description: Get ready for a sweet adventure! Join us for the great gingerbread build where kids can let their imaginations run wild. We’ll provide everything your little builder needs—pre-assembled gingerbread houses, colorful candies, frosting, and plenty of decorating tools.

programs.name: Slime Time- Halloween Edition
programs.description: Get ready to stir up some spooky fun at our Halloween Slime Party! Kids ages 5–11 are invited to mix, stretch, and squish their very own glow-in-the-dark or Halloween-themed slime creations. From creepy colors to sparkly surprises, everyone will go home with a slimy masterpiece!

programs.name: Slime Club
programs.description: Get messy, creative, and have a blast at our Slime Club! Participants will mix, stretch, and customize their own slime creations in this hands-on, fun-filled event.

programs.name: Future Fashion Star
programs.description: This fall we will create a fashion line from concept to collection. The students will work individually and as a team to create their designs.

programs.name: Young Chefs Academy
programs.description: Discover the joys of cooking! Dive into hands-on cooking and baking, create delicious tastings, and learn essential culinary skills like following a recipe, meal prepping, food safety, and kitchen techniques. Please note: Due to the nature of the program, we cannot guarantee the absence of allergens like nuts, gluten, and dairy in the kitchen.

programs.name: Ornament Party - Youth
programs.description: Let the holiday fun begin! You are invited to a festive Ornament Party where kids can create their own one-of-a-kind holiday decorations. We'll provide all the supplies—ornaments, paints, glitter, stickers, and more—so each child can design a few keepsakes to hang on the tree or give as a special gift.

programs.name: Friday Night Game Night
programs.description: Grab your crew and head to the ultimate hangout spot. It’s gonna be a non-stop night of games, music, and PIZZA. Activities will include Billard's (pool), ping pong, foosball, Wii battles and board games. PIZZA WILL BE PROVIDED. This isn’t your average Friday — it’s a full-on teen takeover. Bring your A-game, your appetite. This event is FREE for those that register!

programs.name: Kpop for Kids (Dance)
programs.description: Dance basics, choreography, and body coordination - all set to K-pop music! We’ll conclude 2026’s “Year of the Horse” Lunar New Year with a special horse-inspired dance, complete with horsey tails for the recital performance on the last day of class.

programs.name: Candy Cane Hunt Extravaganza
programs.description: Join the festive fun as we embark on a hunt for Santa's scattered candy canes at the Community Center! But first, let's get creative with some seasonal crafts. Once the crafts are complete, the search begins to find every hidden candy cane. After the hunt, indulge in some treats, listen to a Christmas stories.

programs.name: Create Build LEGO Robotics
programs.description: This program helps kids develop STEM skills by teaching the basics of Scratch programming and robotics through interactive, hands-on activities. Participants will take part in exciting robotic challenges where they can earn medals and ribbons to celebrate accomplishments and build confidence. Kids will also be encouraged to think creatively and solve problems by designing and building LEGO attachments to complete fun tasks and challenges. Collaborative activities, including Robot Battles, will strengthen teamwork and social skills while creating a playful environment where children can learn coding and robotics through engaging, hands-on experiences.

programs.name: Leaveslines-Tea Lifestyle
programs.description: A 5 course interactive series exploring the cultural, creative, and wellness world of tea, spices, herbs, fruits and flowers. This is a premium sensory experience. Each session includes education, tasting, and hands-on blending. Course 1: Understanding Tea: History, Types & Processing. Course 2: Dates with Herbs: herbal & flower tea & blending basics. Course 3: Spice World & the Spice Route & blending basics. Course 4: Mind, Health & Wellness. *Course 4 will take place on Tuesday, October 13*

sections.title: Leaveslines-Tea Lifestyle: Course 2 Dates with Herbs
Leaveslines-Tea Lifestyle: Course 4 Mind, Health & Wellness

programs.name: The Art of Autumn: Pumpkin Painting Night
programs.description: Embrace the cozy vibes of fall with a creative twist! Join us for an adults-only pumpkin painting experience—perfect for a relaxing evening of art, conversation, and seasonal fun. We’ll provide the pumpkins, paints, and inspiration—you bring your imagination (and maybe a friend or two). No carving, no mess—just good vibes and great company.

sections.title: The Art of Autumn: Pumpkin Painting Night

programs.name: Deck the Halls: Wreath Making Fun
programs.description: Get into the holiday spirit with a fun and festive wreath-making event! Join us for a creative session where you’ll craft your own beautiful holiday mesh ribbon wreath to take home. All materials are provided, and no experience is necessary—just bring your holiday cheer and creativity!

sections.title: Deck the Halls: Wreath Making Fun

programs.name: French Country Brunch
programs.description: Experience the flavors of the French countryside in this vegetarian brunch class inspired by the south of France. Prepare Petit Farçis with stuffed seasonal vegetables, a classic Salad Lyonnaise featuring poached egg, and a rustic tomato and goat cheese tart. Learn simple, elegant techniques rooted in Provençal home cooking traditions.

programs.name: Tortellini en Brodo
programs.description: Learn the comforting art of Tortellini en Brodo in this hands-on Italian cooking class. You’ll make fresh pasta dough, savory tortellini filling, and rich homemade bone broth from scratch, then enjoy your handmade soup alongside a bright arugula salad with citrus, fennel, and a light vinaigrette inspired by northern Italy.

programs.name: The Roman Kitchen
programs.description: Transport yourself to the heart of Italy in this hands-on Roman cooking class. Learn to make fresh handmade pasta dough and silky linguine carbonara using traditional techniques and simple ingredients. Complete the meal with misticanza, a vibrant Roman-style salad packed with seasonal vegetables, herbs, and bright Mediterranean flavors.

programs.name: Risotto Workshop
programs.description: Discover the art of creamy Italian risotto in this hands-on workshop featuring three inventive variations. You’ll prepare earthy wild mushroom risotto, smoky elote-inspired sweet corn risotto with cotija and lime, and a comforting apple crisp dessert risotto reminiscent of luxurious rice pudding. Learn essential techniques for perfectly rich, restaurant-worthy risotto from start to finish.

programs.name: Autumn Soups
programs.description: Warm up with comforting autumn classics in this hearty soup and stew workshop. Prepare tender Chicken and Dumpling Soup, silky Roasted Sweet Potato and Vegetable Bisque, and rich Old-Fashioned Beef Red Wine Stew. Learn foundational techniques for building deep flavor, balanced seasoning, and satisfying seasonal dishes perfect for cozy gatherings.

programs.name: Tamale and Salsa Workshop
programs.description: Learn the art of traditional tamales in this hands-on workshop. Prepare fresh masa dough, then assemble corn husk tamales with your choice of chipotle vegetarian or savory pork filling. Craft vibrant salsa roja, salsa verde, cilantro crema, and a fresh avocado salad for a bold, authentic, and flavorful feast.

programs.name: Soufflé Workshop
programs.description: Master the art of the soufflé in this elegant hands-on workshop. Learn essential techniques to achieve height, lightness, and structure while preparing a bright lemon soufflé, rich chocolate soufflé, and warmly spiced pumpkin soufflé. Gain confidence in whisking, folding, and baking for beautifully risen, restaurant-quality desserts every time.

programs.name: Autumn Harvest Brunch
programs.description: Celebrate the flavors of the season with an elegant Autumn Harvest Brunch. You’ll prepare hearty Butternut Squash Strata with gruyere and sage, a savory Goat Cheese and Tomato Tart, and tender Buttermilk Scones with Currants and Orange Zest.

programs.name: Classic Italian Sauces
programs.description: Master classic Italian pasta sauces in this demo/hands-on class, learning techniques, balance, and pasta pairing while preparing pomodoro, Alfredo, pomodoro, pesto, and puttanesca—weeknight-friendly recipes you’ll confidently recreate at home.

programs.name: Elegant Holiday Appetizers
programs.description: Celebrate the season with an elegant holiday appetizer workshop featuring refined party bites perfect for entertaining. Create Mini Beef Wellington Bites with horseradish cream, build-your-own salmon blini with dill whip, and delicate fruit shortcakes finished with chocolate and mint. Learn presentation, balance, and stylish plating for festive gatherings.

programs.name: Mastering Macronutrients with Seasonal Eats
programs.description: This hands-on cooking class led by a dietitian is designed to help you create balanced, nourishing meals throughout the holiday season. We will explore the importance of macronutrients — carbohydrates, proteins, and healthy fats — and how to prepare some fun new recipes for you or your next gathering. Recipes will include some unique new flavors! Register for one class or all four!

programs.name: Autumn in Italy
programs.description: Traditional Italian fall cuisine is deeply regional, seasonal, and rooted in cucina povera — the philosophy of transforming simple ingredients into extraordinary dishes.

programs.name: The Perfect Fall Dinner
programs.description: An ideal autumn dinner is warm, layered, rustic, elegant, and deeply seasonal. This culinary experience will teach you to create an amazing fall dinner at home!

programs.name: Thanksgiving Table Favorites
programs.description: Thanksgiving dinner appetizers, sides, mains and an amazing dessert worthy of compliments for years to come.

programs.name: Where Healthy Meets Delicious
programs.description: Join dietitian Joseph Goldman as we learn exciting recipes, practical cooking tips, and nutrition basics throughout this multi-class series of interactive cooking demonstrations. Oct. 5 and Nov 16: Culinary Basics: Sauces and Dressings. Oct. 19 and Nov. 30: Anti-inflammatory and Antioxidants: Parchment Poached Salmon. Nov. 2 and Dec. 14: Reimagined Favorites: A Dietitian’s Perspective on Desserts.

programs.name: Your Mind-Body Interactions: Conscious Regulation & Transformation
programs.description: Learn WHY and HOW to proactively regulate MIND-BODY INTERACTIONS that produce your positive and negative feelings. Explore evidence-based practices for addressing stress and improving your mental and physical well-being.

programs.name: PJs and Pancakes Family Fun Night
programs.description: Who doesn't love breakfast for dinner? Bring the family for a Friday night treat! Come dressed in your best pajamas and be ready to enjoy a stack of delicious pancakes, a craft and a hot cocoa bar!

sections.title: PJs and Pancakes Family Fun Night

programs.name: Halloween Carnival
programs.description: Get ready for a frightfully fun time at our Halloween Carnival, where magic, mystery, and mayhem await! This kid-friendly event is packed with exciting games, creative crafts, and not-too-spooky surprises perfect for young ghouls and goblins. Adults are free.

programs.name: Make A Difference Day
programs.description: Join us at The Well as we come together to make a difference in Hilliard!In celebration of Make A Difference Day, we’re hosting a special event to assemble goodie bags for families staying at the Ronald McDonald House. It's a simple but powerful way to show kindness and support to those going through tough times.This day reminds us that even small acts of service can lead to meaningful change — and we’d love for you to be part of it!When to donate supplies:We’re collecting donations starting October 1.Please drop them off at The Well.What to bring:• Pudding or fruit cups• Granola bars• Individual bags of chips, popcorn, pretzels, trail mix, or nuts (please label if they contain nuts)• Peanut butter or cheese crackers• Fruit snacks (no fresh fruit)• Small boxes of cerealWe’ll provide the bags and notecards — you bring the generosity!Let’s come together and show that a little kindness goes a long way. We hope to see you there!

programs.name: Family Pizza and Bingo
programs.description: Come join us for an evening of food, fun, and family bonding! Gather around for pizza and dive into multiple rounds of classic bingo with exciting prizes. Whether you're a seasoned bingo pro or a first-time player, everyone can join in on the fun. With laughter, light-hearted competition, and plenty of chances to win, this event promises to be a memorable night for kids, parents, and grandparents alike. It’s the perfect way to relax, reconnect, and create lasting memories together. Registration is per person.

programs.name: Taste of Peace Ohio
programs.description: Join Taste of Peace Ohio and start your new year with some fun and hands-on cooking adventures! Discover the flavors of the world as you learn to make delicious dishes like falafel from Sudan, kimchi from Korea, falafel from Sudan, beehive bread from the Middle East and sushi from Japan. Let's get cooking and share some tasty experiences together! www.tasteofpeaceohio.com
